summary: This work co-fabricates InAs/Al nanowire-based gatemons and SIS-junction transmons on identical high-resistivity silicon substrates with shared circuit layouts and dielectrics to isolate junction-intrinsic dissipation. Co-integrated transmons reach $T_1 = 25.8$–93.8 µs while gatemons saturate at $T_1 = 0.69$–9.1 µs (roughly sixfold gap), with a comprehensive loss budget showing Purcell decay ($T_{1,	ext{Pur}} > 300$ µs), gate-line spontaneous emission ($T_{1,	ext{spont}} > 30$ µs), and internal dielectric loss ($Q_	ext{int} 	imes 2	ext{π} f_q$, tens of microseconds) all exceeding measured gatemon values by $> 10	imes$, indicating temperature-independent junction-intrinsic dissipation.
